rule.name: MkdirsResultAsFailure
rule.message: File.mkdirs() and File.mkdir() return false when the directory already exists, also when another thread or process created it a moment ago, so treating false as a failure throws under concurrent writers. Use Files.createDirectories(dir.toPath()), which does not fail for an existing directory, or if (!dir.mkdirs() && !dir.isDirectory()) throw new IOException(...). An exception fits when the directory was just deleted or has a fresh random name.
